messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a concise, ready‑to‑copy list of the **federal Canadian holidays that create long weekends in 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays, let me know and I can add those too.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | ❌ | Observed on **Jan 2** (Monday) – creates a long weekend (Dec 31–Jan 2). |
| **Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | Monday | ✅ | |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB, PE) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (Feb 18–20). |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (Apr 7–9). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (May 20–22). |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | ❌ | Observed on **Jul 3** (Monday) – creates a long weekend (Jul 1–3). |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (Observed) | Monday | ✅ | |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (Sep 2–4). |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (Oct 7–9). |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (Nov 9–11). |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | ✅ | Creates a long weekend (Dec 23–25). |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | ❌ | Observed on **Dec 27** (Wednesday) – no long weekend. |

### Quick JSON snippet (for your app)

```json
[
  {"date":"2023-01-01","holiday":"New Year’s Day","longWeekend":false,"note":"Observed on 2023-01-02"},
  {"date":"2023-01-02","holiday":"New Year’s Day (Observed)","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-02-20","holiday":"Family Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-04-07","holiday":"Good Friday","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-05-22","holiday":"Victoria Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-07-01","holiday":"Canada Day","longWeekend":false,"note":"Observed on 2023-07-03"},
  {"date":"2023-07-03","holiday":"Canada Day (Observed)","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-09-04","holiday":"Labour Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-10-09","holiday":"Thanksgiving","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-11-11","holiday":"Remembrance Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-12-25","holiday":"Christmas Day","longWeekend":true},
  {"date":"2023-12-26","holiday":"Boxing Day","longWeekend":false}
]
```

Feel free to drop this into your holiday‑planning database or UI. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) or a more detailed calendar, just let me know!
